reviews.comment: Your grade is 10 quizzes; that's it! It seems simple enough EXCEPT they are based on whole books you must read and his lectures. He runs through slides fast, doesn't make them available after the day he presents them online or on paper, and will not let you record the slides or his voice. Rude and entitled behavior made me reconsider my major! Run!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!! Absolutely awful, he only grades off of 12 quizzes that are 5 minutes long for 10 questions. None of the questions can be googled and they aren't even based off of the lectures. I tried hard to do well and took tons of notes, but he just makes the quizzes too difficult. Don't bother asking how to improve, he won't help
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Linn's HIST 230 class, and as long as you show up to his lectures and watch the assigned movies it isn't hard to make an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Linn is a great lecturer and the material was easy if you went to class, no midterm or final. Only complaint is that the weekly quizzes were 100% of your grade so if you don't do well with that format or missed a lecture it was very impactful on your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
The syllabus says this week's topic is World War I, watch the movie and study the relevant material, but the professor decided to quiz us on the Spanish American War. 

All quizzes so far have been ridiculous since his lectures rarely prepare us. 

The final essay will be a waste of time since he grades so harshly, so why bother? Great job, prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Prof. Linn is somewhat of a harsh professor. Be sure to respect him, because there were times where he would snap at students at class in front of everyone. He also grades based on twelve 10 question quizzes, so pay attention and read the reading. He lectures, but doesn't really teach. Also, you will have to take notes really fast.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take him! He is very kind and will assist you when you feel out of your element. I learned a lot in his class, not only in history but also how to be a better student. Dr. Linn recognizes effort and will assist you in any way he can. This class was difficult, I have never been more proud of my A! Take him if you want learn a lot and earn your A!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 50% of your grade is 40 minutes - 10 completely absurd attendance-like quizzes with a time limit of 4 minutes for 10 questions each over military history. Other 50% of your grade is an essay with unclear, convoluted citation guidance which he will harshly grade. Insanely fast "lectures" with lots of notes with very little to do with the quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lots of quizzes and one paper. Getting bad grades on the quizzes will really tank your grade quickly so stay on top of them.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is there to lecture, not so much to teach. Lectures are his "own intellectual property" so you better be fast at taking notes or good luck. No taking pictures and they are not available outside of class. Quizzes are 10 questions with only 4 sometimes 3 minutes to complete.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He never left a question unanswered, and remained completely objective the entire course. He has so much information to give. The hardest part was keeping up with the reading.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Linn is one of the most laid back/ strict professor I have ever experienced in my life. Don't want to show up to class? Cool, but the 5 question weekly quizzes will quickly tank your grade(you'll also never know what they're over, reading or lectures). He will work with you, so reach out to him. He also asked for my opinion on quiz questions...
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great lecturer and really easy quizzes that you will pass as long as you show up. Daily clicker polls to take attendance. However, he absolutely shreds the final essay to pieces, so just mentally prep for that. You should get a B as long as you follow the instructions closely for the essay and show up to class
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Linn will give you everything you need to succeed. Assuming you study the material outside of class (Read the book, watch the assigned movies etc) but never anything overwhelming. He's obviously very passionate about the subject so he puts extra effort into lectures and some humor as well. One of my favorite classes without a doubt!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Linn is a good and passionate professor, but the quizzes and material in class make it difficult to get an A. Good luck remembering the names of all the generals and specifically which campaign in which war led to a specific outcome.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Linn knows his stuff, just not how to properly teach a class. 50 percent of your grade is attendance-like quizzes and the remainder is this huge ass paper over two books. That man will dissect that essay to pieces, oh and he also prides on the average being at a 70 percent. NOT AN EASY A AND BORING LECTURES. I wouldn't take him again
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Linn is the best professor I've ever had. His lectures are absolutely amazing and he is so funny. He is extremely knowledgeable about all that he teaches always makes sure everyone grasps what he's teaching. I wish I could take this class every semester. I will miss it very much.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Brian Linn is overall a great prof. I took him for military history and enjoyed the class very much. He is extremely knowledgeable in the subject, be ready to take notes because he doesn't give powerpoints. The main thing you have to do is read the books early!! The only real grades you have are like 4 short essays you do over these assigned books.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Linn is extremely knowledgeable in his field of American Military History and being in his class is a privilege learning from such an expert, but that being said nothing gets passed him in any essay you write for him, normally in a class like this I'd expect an A, but the way he picks an essay apart is hard to get around.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: For a 200 level course, ridiculous. You have to read 4+ novels. He knowledgeable, but the lectures are still extremely dry.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really great professor. Extremely knowledgeable and is very engaging lecture style.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very funny. If you miss class, this class would be so hard. If you read ahead in the textbook you can impress him in class. His quizzes are kind of hard, the answers mostly come from lectures. His class is fun, it had the highest attendance rate of any class I have ever taken.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. He has almost weekly clicker quizzes, but if you go to class and kinda pay attention, they're super easy. No tests at all. The essay at the end of the year was a little tough though. Overall, he is a super nice guy who is very intelligent and makes class fun and easy! Would definitely take him again!
The class was a lot of fun but the essay at the end of the semester is kinda scary
Great Prof. Very engaging and has great stories and anecdotes. Study notes for almost daily quizzes. Gives great extra credit. If you he sees your initiative, you will get an A.

This past semester I took American Military History class with Prof. Linn and by far it is my favorite class this semester. I never was much of a history buff before this class but my interest has been spiked. There is a lot of reading for his classes, but most of the novels are interesting. This is a class I looked forward to every day.
